explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/661: for all large n, are there x₁,…,x_n, y₁,…,y_n ∈ ℝ² with o(n/√log n) distinct distances d(x_i, y_j)? minimalCrossDistances ℝ² n is the minimum over disjoint n-sets A, B of the number of cross distances. Requiring the 2n points to be distinct is the necessary non-degeneracy (otherwise there is one distance), and the docstring explains it. The question is stated as F(n) = o(n/√log n), which is equivalent since the minimum is attained. Faithful.
